rationale:
Issue #521 describes Cookie header values being incorrectly joined with commas instead of semicolons per RFC 6265. The production fix adds an optional 'name' parameter to joinHeaderValues() and uses '; ' separator when the header name is 'cookie' (case-insensitive), correctly addressing the defect. The minimized patch is identical to production-fix.patch and contains only the necessary changes to headers.dart and util.dart without CHANGELOG or test modifications. The trigger test validates that multiple cookie values ['session=123', 'theme=dark'] are joined as 'session=123; theme=dark' in the headers map while preserving the array in headersAll—this directly tests the reported defect and was added in the same fixing commit. Runtime evidence shows all strict checks passed: buggy version reproduces only the trigger test, fixed version passes all tests, trigger is deterministic and differential. No active same-project root causes exist to conflict.

Issue #521 reports that multiple Cookie header values are incorrectly joined with commas instead of '; ' per RFC 6265. The trigger test verifies this exact behavior: it creates a message with Cookie headers ['session=123', 'theme=dark'] and expects the single-value map to contain 'session=123; theme=dark'. The minimized production patch modifies joinHeaderValues to accept an optional name parameter and use '; ' separator when name is 'cookie' (case-insensitive), with all three call sites (Headers.singleValues and two findHeader locations) updated to pass the header name. No CHANGELOG, documentation-only, or unrelated changes are present in the minimized patch. The trigger test was added in the fixing commit itself (later_trigger_score: 100, later_trigger_commit matches fixed_revision). Runtime evidence shows all strict checks passed: buggy version reproduces only the declared trigger, fixed version is clean, trigger is deterministic across 3 repetitions, and the build passes on both versions. No active same-project root causes exist to conflict with this defect.
